artifacts.name: rootless-installer
artifacts.note: The final executed installer bytes are rendered from the immutable docker-install template after verifying its template digest. The three LOAD_SCRIPT_* values are pinned in the manifest and substituted deterministically; the resulting bytes are independently checked against the final digest before execution. The stable version selects docker-ce-rootless-extras and its dockerd-rootless.sh, dockerd-rootless-setuptool.sh and rootlesskit payload. See docs/supply-chain-pinning.md.

artifacts.name: rootless-installer-template
artifacts.note: Immutable template at this docker-install commit. The LOAD_SCRIPT_* substitution values (script_commit_sha=ada7a567e59b3935bd601bb21e422da50e80e376, stable_latest=29.9.2, test_latest=29.9.2) are pinned here, so executed bytes are a pure function of two immutable inputs. The final rootless-installer artifact digest remains 9f227ab1eefb3e4df6b0f26345da8b2149fded68e4afc8a4e450f2f063c8bebc and matches the testdata fixture.

artifacts.name: slirp4netns
artifacts.note: Rootless-containers static binary, used only when the host has no slirp4netns package and the distribution has no package strategy. Pinned to a release asset (never releases/latest/download, which is a moving target) and verified before it is installed to /usr/local/bin.

artifacts.name: fuse-overlayfs
artifacts.note: Containers static binary, used only when the host has no fuse-overlayfs package. Pinned to a release asset and verified before it is installed to /usr/local/bin.
